name: browser-use
headline: SkillsWeaver - AI-Powered RPG Engine
short_description: SkillsWeaver is an interactive tabletop RPG engine powered by Claude Code. It enables operations teams to create and manage role-playing games with AI orchestration. The engine is based on Basic Fantasy RPG rules and supports Claude agents. It can be used for team-building exercises, training simulations, and collaborative problem-solving.
author: nicmarti

sections.overview:
SkillsWeaver is an interactive tabletop RPG engine based on D&D 5e rules that combines Claude AI orchestration with Go CLI tools to create complete role-playing experiences. The platform offers both a web interface and command-line tools for creating adventures, managing characters, and running game sessions with real-time streaming responses. It automates campaign planning with 3-act structures, generates antagonists and plot elements, produces tactical combat maps, and handles character progression through level-ups and treasure generation. Teams can use SkillsWeaver for collaborative storytelling, training simulations, team-building exercises, and interactive problem-solving scenarios. The Fortune-Teller Wizard guides adventure creation through tarot-card-based world-building, while the web interface provides character management, party tracking, and inline image generation for immersive gameplay.
Create structured D&D campaigns with automatic 3-act planning and NPC generation
Run interactive team-building exercises using collaborative role-playing scenarios
Conduct training simulations with AI-driven storytelling and tactical decision-making
Generate tactical combat encounters with inline maps and automated treasure rewards
A team of adventurers must recover the Lost Artifact of Eldoria, a powerful relic hidden deep within the Whispering Woods. The artifact is said to grant wisdom and unity to those who possess it, making it the perfect metaphor for teamwork and collaboration.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/nicmarti/skills-weaver`
sections.usage:
```
Create a new SkillsWeaver RPG campaign for a team-building exercise at [COMPANY]. The campaign should be set in a fantasy world where the team must collaborate to solve [CHALLENGE]. Include at least 3 NPCs with distinct personalities and 2 key locations. Use Basic Fantasy RPG rules and ensure the campaign is suitable for [NUMBER_OF_PLAYERS] players.
```
Copy

```
# SkillsWeaver RPG Campaign: The Lost Artifact of Eldoria
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
